name: symfony-route-resolver
description: Clickable links for Symfony route names — navigates directly to the PHP controller declaration.

symfony-route-resolver.symfonyBinaryPath.description: Path to the Symfony CLI binary. Defaults to `symfony` (must be in $PATH).

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile-rust && npm run package
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.package:linux: npm run compile-rust:linux && vsce package --target linux-x64
scripts.package:linux-arm: npm run compile-rust:linux-arm && vsce package --target linux-arm64
scripts.package:mac: npm run compile-rust:mac && vsce package --target darwin-x64
scripts.package:mac-arm: npm run compile-rust:mac-arm && vsce package --target darwin-arm64
scripts.package:windows: npm run compile-rust:windows && vsce package --target win32-x64
